prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] story_video_overview_redesign: Redesign the story screen into a spotlight layout featuring an animated video preview of pet desktop interactions.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "components": [{"type": "video", "asset": "asset:intro_video", "style": "rounded"}]}}
1: [sign_in, hint] sign_in_benefit_checklist_hint: Display a hint on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in saves pet memory across computer reboots and updates.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in ensures your pet's memory, traits, and progress stay saved across app restarts."}}
2: [adoption, redesign] pick_friend_grid_layout_redesign: Rebuild the pet selection screen into a multi-column grid layout with popular choice badges for faster browsing.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Choose Your Pet Companion", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Most Popular", "style": "playful"}]}}
3: [adoption, wait_info] photo_upload_wait_info_tips: Add a tip carousel component during photo upload to guide users on lighting and angles for custom pet generation.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Use well-lit single subject photos for best 3D pet rendering results.", "style": "calm"}]}}
4: [home, new_flow] waiting_screen_interactive_flow: Enable progress bars, time estimates, and background notification triggers while the pet assets render.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "progress", "text": "Rendering your pet's 3D desktop model...", "style": "highlight"}]}}
5: [finish, new_screen] home_intro_desktop_interaction_guide: Add a new desktop controls walkthrough screen right after home intro to explain pet interactions.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet is Ready!", "body": "Let's quickly learn how to interact with your pet on the desktop."}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_desktop_controls_walkthrough"]}
6: [choose_path, incentive] choose_path_time_estimate_incentive: Display a quick setup time estimate and highlight badge on the path selection screen.
   config: {"choose_path": {"show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Quick 2-Minute Setup", "style": "highlight"}]}}
7: [adoption, layout] adoption_certificate_badge_redesign: Update adoption certificate layout to full_bleed and add an official seal achievement badge.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "full_bleed", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Official Pet Companion Certificate", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
8: [sign_in, notification] sign_in_troubleshoot_notification: Show a helpful text notification after a delay if the user stalls on sign in screen.
   config: {"sign_in": {"tip_delay_seconds": 15, "components": [{"type": "text", "text": "Taking longer than expected? Check your internet connection or continue as guest.", "style": "subtle"}]}}
9: [finish, layout] finish_home_intro_checklist_layout: Switch home_intro to a checklist layout showing key first-day actions (drag pet, open controls, feed pet).
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "Getting Started with Your Pet", "body": "Complete these quick steps to make your desktop pet feel at home."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns story screen while continuing to introduce the pet.
Adds an informative hint to the sign-in screen without violating pricing or fair design rules.
Redesigns pet selection into a grid layout with standard social proof.
Adds photo tips and time estimates to the upload screen.
Enhances the waiting screen showing real rendering progress.
Adds a walkthrough screen after home_intro, which is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.
Displays a realistic setup time estimate on the choose path screen.
Replaces components on the adoption certificate with a badge, losing the required official stamp.
Offering an option to continue as a guest makes the sign-in step skippable.
Redesigns the home intro overlay into a checklist layout inside onboarding.
